scope: Review the hugepage documentation and its B550 A/B evidence, confirm the Optane/driver work is out of scope and untouched, audit the MLX DFlash2 prediction-head distillation template and its new full-logit/QAT trainer commits, and record the live cloud (Prime) DSpark-weighted parameter state for Qwen3.8-27B. No GPU work was performed on B550 or Strix.

hugepages.doc: docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md Linux explicit-2MiB-hugepage section plus docs/architecture.md decision entry
hugepages.review_verdict: Correct and self-consistent. The B550 A/B (2 arms x 2 interleaved rounds, 8 warm requests each) showed explicit hugetlb cut the 32.23 GiB expert-load phase from a 47.5 s median to 40 s but left warm decode tied (217.1 vs 217.45 tok/s, control marginally faster) with identical 71/72 draft acceptance and one output-content SHA-256. Decision: do not persist vm.nr_hugepages; page ownership stays a host operator action, never a server ExecStop side effect.
hugepages.boundary_confirmed: vm.nr_hugepages is currently 0 on B550; nothing was changed.

optane_and_gpu_boundary.instruction: User reported active Optane driver twiddling; stay off B550 GPUs.
optane_and_gpu_boundary.action: No nvidia-smi probe, engine launch, or training job was run on B550 or Strix this turn. All GPU work was confined to the existing Prime cloud pod.

mlx_dflash2_prediction_head_template.prediction_head_seam: DFlashDraftModel.forward_projected_context produces draft hidden states; the target LM head is supplied externally by TargetOps.logits_from_hidden (MLX) and by --lm-head safetensors (PyTorch trainer). The draft checkpoint deliberately owns no lm_head; loading.py raises if a draft-owned lm_head is present. This is the correct template: the drafter shares the frozen target head, so a Flash-Next port swaps the head and target-feature projection, not the head ownership model.
mlx_dflash2_prediction_head_template.capture: scripts/capture_dflash2_distillation.py --full-logits stores target_logits F32 [5,248320] per cycle plus anchor/context/raw_context/noise_embedding/selector_hidden/top64/greedy; full-vocab logits are exactly what the DSpark TV and confidence objectives require.
mlx_dflash2_prediction_head_template.trainer_objectives: selector (top-64 CE), distribution (full-vocab CE+TV via the frozen LM head), hybrid (both); configurable --selector-weight/--distribution-ce-weight/--distribution-tv-weight; loss-reduction mean|sum.
mlx_dflash2_prediction_head_template.qat: --qat-mxfp4 fake-quantizes the effective LoRA weight and the selector projection through fake_quantize_mxfp4 (MXFP4 grid, straight-through gradient); merge path also re-quantizes. This supersedes the earlier PTQ-only boundary.
mlx_dflash2_prediction_head_template.hardening_5f47153: float32 selector path, dtype-safe LoRA merge, --selection-metric auto with a prefix-only-for-selector guard, a training fingerprint (model+capture SHA-256, hyperparameters) bound into checkpoints and receipts, and full-logit export quantization.
mlx_dflash2_prediction_head_template.local_validation: 20/20 tests pass in tests/test_dflash2_distill.py including MXFP4 straight-through gradient and aligned full-vocab distribution loss.

cloud_prime_lane.pod: dflash-full-logit-2, RTX 6000 Ada 48 GB x1, provider massedcompute, image ubuntu_22_cuda_12
cloud_prime_lane.billing: Prime wallet $49.54; Modal free credits effectively exhausted (17.74 consumed vs 17.00 credits), so Prime is the active lane.
cloud_prime_lane.concurrent_owner: A user tmux session dflash-lr-ext is running the DSpark-weighted hybrid sweep (ce 0.1, tv 0.9) on the single GPU; it was preserved, never stopped.

codex_qat_smoke.config: hybrid loss, rank 8, alpha 16, lr 2e-7, MXFP4 QAT, Triton dynamic conv, 128-cycle pilot, seed 43
codex_qat_smoke.result: exit 0; 99 steps in 164 s; 13.4 GiB peak GPU; best validation CE 6.039, TV 0.939
codex_qat_smoke.finding: MXFP4 QAT is roughly 11x slower than the BF16 full-replay path (164 s vs ~15 s for 128 cycles), so QAT must stay a winner-only step, not a sweep default.

cloud_prime_lane.armed_then_disarmed_watcher: Codex armed a fail-closed watcher to auto-start a weights-1.0 baseline on the incoming 12,000-cycle slice; after detecting the user dflash-lr-ext job already owning the single GPU, Codex killed the watcher (confirmed gone, no training dir created) to avoid contention and a duplicate baseline. The 12,000-cycle slice transfer continues untouched.

measured_lr_trend.corpus: captures/fable-full-logits-frozen4096 (4096 cycles, full F32 vocab logits)
measured_lr_trend.objective: hybrid, DSpark weights ce 0.1 / tv 0.9, rank 8, alpha 16, seed 73, weight-decay 1e-4, validation-fraction 0.05
measured_lr_trend.interpretation: Monotonic improvement with rising LR through 4e-6; the user sweep is extending upward and running a 2e-6/2-epoch arm. On this frozen 4096-cycle full-logit corpus the DSpark2-Qwen LR floor is at or above 4e-6 for rank 8, materially higher than the earlier selector-only regime (~1e-6).

dspark_weights_comparison.note: Hybrid adds the selector CE and prefix metric for roughly 2x the wall time at the same distribution loss; distribution-only is the cheaper pure-logit arm, hybrid is the arm that keeps selector prefix quality measurable.

cloud_prime_lane.triton_kernel: DFLASH_TRITON_BLOCK_GROUPS=32, DFLASH_TRITON_NUM_WARPS=4 was best on Ada (mean 1.518x isolated conv speedup) and is the kernel config for cloud Triton arms.

parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.student: promoted DFlash2 G3 full head (rank-8 LoRA), not selector-only
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.objective: hybrid selector CE + full-vocab teacher CE + TV, DSpark weights ce 0.1 / tv 0.9
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.corpus: full-logit capture (F32 [5,248320]); the frozen4096 corpus is the current sweep bed, the 12,000-cycle slice is the scale-up bed
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.lr: start at 4e-6 and continue upward until validation CE stops improving; the 5e-7..4e-6 band is monotonically better and 4e-6 is not yet the plateau
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.epochs: 1 to start; 2-epoch arms are the extension
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.precision: BF16 select-first; MXFP4 --qat-mxfp4 only on the BF16 winner, given the ~11x cost
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.seed: sweep seed 73 is the current cloud seed; 43 was the smoke seed
parameter_recommendation_dspark2_qwen27b.promotion: offline validation CE and prefix accuracy rank trials only; exact 256-token parity then paired live acceptance against the G3 incumbent is the acceptance gate, unchanged
